title: U.S. and Portugal convene 53rd Standing Bilateral Commission meeting
excerpt: The governments confirmed the inaugural CEO Forum Plenary Meeting to be held on November 10, 2026, in Lisbon.
bodyHtml:
The governments of the United States and the Portuguese Republic convened the 53rd meeting of the Portugal-United States Standing Bilateral Commission, according to the US State Department.

The dialogue focused on defense and security cooperation, cooperation in the Azores and Lajes, and economic security. Both delegations reaffirmed NATO’s central role in Euro-Atlantic security and their shared commitment to allied defense investment in line with commitments made at the 2025 NATO Summit in The Hague. Both sides confirmed the inaugural CEO Forum Plenary Meeting to be held on November 10, 2026, in Lisbon.

The United States congratulated Portugal on its election to the UN Security Council for the 2027-2028 term, and both delegations agreed to cooperate within the Council to address pressing topics of the global agenda. The 54th Standing Bilateral Commission will meet in Lisbon in 2027.
